name: Industrial Securities Co.,Ltd.
summary: Industrial Securities Co.,Ltd. is a prominent Chinese financial institution, operating as a comprehensive securities firm. The company offers a wide array of services across the capital markets, including traditional brokerage for securities trading, proprietary trading (self-operation), and margin financing. Its investment banking division handles underwriting and sponsorship for new issuances, alongside bond issuance advisory. The firm also provides extensive financial and investment consulting, facilitates the agency sales of funds and other financial products, and offers asset custody services. Beyond these core offerings, Industrial Securities is involved in credit financing, provides a full spectrum of futures-related services (from introduction to IB activities), and conducts in-depth market research. It also participates in specialized risk management and delisting advisory panels. The company was founded in 1991 and maintains its headquarters in Fuzhou, China.
